title: Add a payment method
summary: The methods chosen when charging. Cash equivalents go into the cash count.

steps.title: New payment method
steps.details: Opens the new payment method form.

steps.title: Code
steps.details: Optional: abbreviation for reports and exports.

steps.title: Does it count as cash?
steps.details: If checked, what's collected with this method adds to the physical cash register's cash and is counted in the cash count. Cards and transfers stay unchecked.
steps.description: Check it if the money goes into the physical cash register (cash). Cards and transfers, no.

steps.title: Save the payment method
steps.details: Saves the payment method and it becomes available on every payment.
